## Read this before updating

- The app id is now `org.kurodev.dotlink` (it was `com.dotlink.android` on the phone and `dev.dotlink.Dotlink` on the PC). On the phone this is a new app: install it, uninstall the old Dotlink, and pair again.
- Mac: Dotlink is now signed with its own certificate. Allow it once more under Accessibility and Local Network (remove the old Dotlink entry with − first); from now on updates keep these permissions.

## Fixes

- Mac: permissions (Accessibility, Local Network) no longer stop working after every update.
- PC: pairing Cast with a phone no longer fails with "protocol fault (couldn't read status message)" when adb can't reach the phone: Dotlink restarts adb's server and tries again, and otherwise says what to check.
